data.title: ACH Return Rate Anomaly
data.description: Detects ACH originators with an elevated return or reversal rate exceeding normal thresholds. High ACH return rates (especially R10 unauthorized, R29 corporate not authorized) may indicate the account is being used to initiate unauthorized debits against victim accounts.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for ACH Return Rate Anomaly")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_returns | count() by originator_id > 5")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:ach_processing event_type="ACH_RETURN" (return_code="R10" OR return_code="R29" OR return_code="R07" OR return_code="R08")
| stats count as event_count by originator_id
| where event_count > 5

falsepositives: Legitimate businesses with high dispute rates due to subscription billing models
Payroll processors during seasonal employment transitions
